body:
Source: GitHub issue #765 (bug, false-green, P1-high, area:platform). Re-verified on main @ 91d2fba0: packages/skill-rot/lib/find-skills.mjs:47-50. In `collectSkills()`, readdirSync({withFileTypes:true}) entries are inspected with `entry.isDirectory()` and `entry.isFile()`. A Dirent for a symlink returns false for both. Consequently, any skill reachable through a symlinked directory (e.g. `skills/foo -> ../shared/foo`) or a symlinked `SKILL.md` is silently skipped with no warning, and the gate exits 0 reporting clean.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/skill-rot`: `bin/skill-rot.mjs` (CLI entry point), `lib/find-skills.mjs` (findSkills, collectSkills), `lib/rot-checker.mjs`, `lib/format.mjs`. Tests: `npm test -w packages/skill-rot` from the worktree root. Rails: `packages/skill-rot/lib/extract-claims.mjs`, `packages/skill-rot/lib/verify-claims.mjs`, `packages/skill-rot/test/frontmatter-preserve.test.mjs`.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In `packages/skill-rot/lib/find-skills.mjs`: in `collectSkills`, handle `entry.isSymbolicLink()` by resolving the link with `statSync(fullPath)` (following the target). If the resolved target is a directory, recursively collect skills; if it is a file named `SKILL.md`, add it to `results`.
2. Cycle guard: track visited directory realpaths (using `realpathSync`) in a Set to prevent infinite recursion on recursive symlink graphs.
3. Broken symlinks: in `strict` mode throw an error; in non-strict mode ignore/skip gracefully.
4. Documentation: update `packages/skill-rot/README.md` and make the SAME edit by hand in `docs/tools/skill-rot.md` and `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/skill-rot.mdx` (hand-maintained mirrors — never regenerate).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 A skill located inside a symlinked directory is discovered and inspected. verify: `node --test packages/skill-rot/test/symlink-skills.test.mjs`
- AC2 A symlinked SKILL.md file is discovered and inspected. verify: `node --test packages/skill-rot/test/symlink-skills.test.mjs`
- AC3 Cyclic symlinks do not loop infinitely. verify: `node --test packages/skill-rot/test/symlink-skills.test.mjs`
- AC4 Existing test suite passes with no regressions. verify: `npm test -w packages/skill-rot`
- AC5 Docs updated in all three mirror files. verify: `grep -c "symlink" packages/skill-rot/README.md docs/tools/skill-rot.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/skill-rot.mdx` (each >= 1)
- AC6 Mutation gate green on branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12`

OUT OF SCOPE: Issue #766 (zero claims last-verified).
title: skill-rot: follow symlinked directories and SKILL.md files with cycle detection
